integrity: Exact finite-dimensional linear-algebra proof using a cited prime Fourier-minors lemma; finite checks are separate and not substitutes for that lemma.
scientific_limitations: Only prime-order Paley graphs p congruent to 1 modulo 4; prime-power example shows placement-dependence.
No disorder, dephasing, rate-of-absorption estimates or finite-time speed claim.
Multi-sink priority risk persists for unindexed literature; full-spark theorem and single-sink case are previously known.
title: A placement-independent quantum absorption threshold on prime Paley networks
